page.content:
Wish-magic crown that turns Simon into the Ice King.

How Ice Crown connects

  • Character: Ice King — The Ice King is the crown's worn-down wearer.
  • Character: Simon Petrikov — Simon put on the Ice Crown and began to lose himself.

What is Ice Crown?

The Ice Crown grants ice power and immortality at the price of the wearer's mind — the object that made Simon Petrikov the Ice King.

Key threads lead to Ice King and Simon Petrikov.
